notes.title: It's been a month since last update, and many new things got in ShipCrafter
notes.notes:
Hello !



Yes it has already been a month without a community post, but rest assured the game kept being updated in the meantime.

In particular we now have fully configurable custom missions. It is now possible to select allied bots, the time of day, the weather, and even to view bot vs bot battles in spectator mode. Also bots are now able to use torpedos as well, making battle more diverse and challenging.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/ed56b3231b19ce7615f412744aea8cc3f2e478b9.png"]

A mirror mode was added to the build scene as well, making ship building twice as fast.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/2dd3891afb3c822228594f3b06e26732b65fb161.png"]

Cosmetics can now be stretched and shifted to allow more variations in your build.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/6ba958542ad6025ee08b6a5f034fcd6790e47b87.png"]



Finally, many ships were completed in prevision of the release. Here are a few select pictures of them :


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/0dbee645caff43fd2b2563a0d5161b0318fb15f2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/0fd3cd2208e05cf6701429d0202330b641ca2327.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694800/6bab17ae9b9543aa26e5a741cd77dccad38fbb6e.png"]

That's it for this log, of course many bugs were fixed and lots small features were added as well.

See you for the next post !

notes.title: A new update comes in ShipCrafter
notes.notes:
Hello, a new update is now available ! Here are the changes : 

added special mission types : one is available in the demo, the Minekaze, along with its unlockable armament,

added mission type : defense of point against raiding enemies (mission n°7),

first person view in battles and custom battles, even allowiing you to aim and shoot in this view,

anchor cosmetic,

changed build scene esthetics, it should be clearer and more optimised,

changed weaponery naming,

changed barriers and column cosmetics,

improved canons VFX
